title: Design System: 免费 API 中文索引

motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Card hover and category/filter state changes.

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Neutral paper stamp with a colored square and always-visible label.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid #9f9789; border-radius: 2px; color: #11100e; background: #f3f0e7; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 4px; background: #9a5b00; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter used for authentication and quota scopes.
components.css: .ds-filter { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #ff4d00; border-radius: 999px; color: #11100e; background: #ff4d00; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4d00; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Export Button
components.css: .ds-export { padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #11100e; border-radius: 2px; color: #f3f0e7; background: #11100e; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-export:hover { border-color: #ff4d00; color: #11100e; background: #ff4d00; } .ds-export:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4d00; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A warm-paper trade catalogue with black ink, a single safety-orange marker, hairline rules, and square API records. The interface stays a working directory: search, filters, pagination, and evidence are always standard and visible.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground with black ink and one safety-orange action color.
Instrument Sans display and working text with a system Chinese fallback.
Twenty API cards per page in a two-column grid with explicit pagination.
Neutral category markers; only the active category becomes an ink block.

rules.name: The Orange Registration Rule
rules.body: Safety Orange marks action, current state, and one masthead square. It never becomes a background wash.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay paper-like; do not reintroduce dark dashboard chrome or neon accents.

rules.name: The Card Record Rule
rules.body: Every API card uses the same evidence slots and a bottom-anchored footer; hover changes surface and border, not geometry.

rules.name: The Explicit Page Rule
rules.body: The directory paginates at 20 records; no infinite scroll.

rules.name: The Microtype Floor
rules.body: No supporting text below 10px; mono evidence is 11px/500 and numeric metadata is 12px.

dos: Use Instrument Sans and the system Chinese fallback together.
Keep the baseline at 500 weight with subpixel antialiasing; no 400-weight UI text.
Keep status labels visible and use the square as a second signal.
Let the paper and rules carry the composition.
donts: Don't reintroduce neon accents or multicolor category systems.
Don't use decorative shadows, gradients, or glass.
Don't turn cards into decorative tiles.
Don't replace the pagination with infinite scroll.
